responsibility: Defines the shared function-call ABI model used by `rustc_target`, including pass modes, argument attributes, register and cast representations, `ArgAbi`/`FnAbi` operations, and the dispatcher that adjusts a `FnAbi` for each target architecture and foreign ABI.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the central function-call ABI framework: it defines `PassMode`, argument attributes, `ArgAbi`/`FnAbi`, and dispatches to per-architecture call-lowering code, rather than target-spec infrastructure or inline-asm plumbing.
